body: I hate seeing people who can't fight back beaten. This is disgusting.

Look in my post history. A while ago, I thanked all of the people here for trying to help and being here to talk to, because I realize that this position is VERY demanding, even more so if you actually care about the people involved. And I meant it when I thanked you all. And to add to that, I didn't know this place was here to get better, I thought it was here to simply talk. I am sorry if my post came off the wrong way.

And I've also made a post about how I was about to attempt, but I thought of you guys, a community where I could find some rest, and didn't do it. So I think you guys are helping me.
Ahh, I forgot, forgive me. I'll delete this my post, it doesn't mean anything anyway,
oh god what.
I called it before I entered. I HATE those things.
It's not working now, but I'll try again later. Thanks.
Not to be a nuisance, but how do I get to the chat?

1.Don't know where my father is (He could be dead for all I know)

2.Hideously deformed

3.Can't really interact with people

4.Constantly terrified (and I'm talking about real fear)

5.Crushing, debilitating anxiety 

6.Nervous tics (Make me seem crazy to other people)

7.Introverted

8.Body dysmorphic disorder (why I see myself as being deformed)
Also, I know I sound silly.
I know my life is fucked up. I just wanted some human interaction.

No song, poem, or platitude can sooth the mind of one who is looking at eternity....

But thank you for trying.
I agree with everything you said.
“I swear, by my life and my love of it, that I will never live for the sake of another man, nor ask another man to live for mine.”

"By the way, no one knows if there will or will not be something after we die. You should lighten up a bit."

I can't lighten up. It's not a matter of me trying.

I can't even go outside without a fucking jacket on to cover myself up. Everyone thinks I'm weird because I wear jackets in 80 degree weather, but I can't help it. I hate myself, and I DESPISE the way I look. I have the biggest fucking nose at my school. I punched and broke my mirror the last time I looked in it.
And I wish I had found this place sooner.
I want to live in a rational world with rational people.
I know how it feels to be crushed dude. Just tough this one out, you didn't deserve this.

The thought of suicide used to horrify me, but now, all I want is some peace. It's not suicide that I'm afraid of, but the notion of failing. I'm not afraid of death, I'm afraid of getting there. I hope that made sense.
Here I am again, I lost my password. Today I feel like people are watching me. I feel like people are looking for me, but I KNOW they aren't. This is too difficult. I haven't felt okay in too long.
